mapper.select: SELECT uc.user_card_id AS userCardId, c.card_id AS cardId, c.card_name AS cardName, c.card_image_url AS cardImageUrl, c.benefits_info AS benefitsInfo, cms.target_year_month AS targetYearMonth, COALESCE(cms.total_spending_amount, 0) AS totalSpendingAmount FROM user_cards uc INNER JOIN cards c ON c.card_id = uc.card_id LEFT JOIN card_monthly_status cms ON cms.user_card_id = uc.user_card_id AND cms.target_year_month = #{targetYearMonth} WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND uc.status = 'ACTIVE' AND uc.recommendation_enabled = TRUE AND uc.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.is_supported = TRUE

SELECT cms.user_card_id AS userCardId, cms.target_year_month AS targetYearMonth, cms.total_spending_amount AS totalSpendingAmount FROM card_monthly_status cms INNER JOIN user_cards uc ON uc.user_card_id = cms.user_card_id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND uc.status = 'ACTIVE' AND uc.recommendation_enabled = TRUE AND uc.deleted_at IS NULL AND cms.target_year_month >= #{fromYearMonth}
SELECT m.merchant_id AS merchantId, m.merchant_name AS merchantName, m.category_code AS categoryCode, m.brand_id AS brandId FROM merchants m WHERE m.merchant_id = #{merchantId}

SELECT benefit_service_name AS serviceName, target_year_month AS targetYearMonth, used_amount AS usedAmount, used_count AS usedCount FROM card_benefit_monthly_usage WHERE user_card_id = #{userCardId} AND target_year = #{targetYear}
